verdict.rationale: Skyfire gives merchants some coarse-grained control: services can require KYA/KYA-Pay identity verification so unverified buyer agents are denied ('token creation fails and the transaction does not proceed'), and sellers configure per-service 'identity requirements' during approval, plus a mention that a site or bot manager can identify an agent/platform and allow it through (docs-3, docs-10, supp-2, docs-17). However, there is no documented mechanism for rate-limiting specific agents, nor for building an explicit allow/deny list of named agents or agent platforms beyond identity-tier gating. Missing for 10: rate-limiting controls, granular per-agent/platform allow/deny lists (vs. verification-tier gating), and any dashboard/API for merchants to manage such rules.
